summary: Smart Search + Subscriptions tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 23/23 passed (search suggest with synonyms dhaniya->coriander & bhindi->okra, unavailable exclusion, product filters min_price/max_price/in_stock, aloo->potato synonym, subscription create with pincode+non-empty items validation, weekly next_delivery_date aligns to weekly_day and is tomorrow-minimum, pause/resume/frequency-change recomputes next date, skip advances by frequency, GET /subscriptions excludes cancelled, admin/subscriptions list, admin/stats.active_subscriptions, admin/subscriptions/run generates COD order with source='subscription' and decrements stock and advances next_delivery_date and increments orders_generated, legacy /subscriptions/boxes and /admin/subscription-boxes correctly removed -> 404). Frontend: Shop 'search-input' typing 'dhaniya' shows 'suggest-box' with 'Also matching: coriander' hint + Coriander suggestions; tapping suggest-<id> navigates to /product/<id>. Filter modal: 'filter-btn' opens sheet, 'price-u50' + 'instock-switch' + 'filter-apply' filters grid (all cards shown are ₹49 <=50) and 'filter-reset' works. Subscription create flow: OTP login (mock 123456) -> /addresses create (400001 default) -> Shop add 2 items -> Cart -> 'subscribe-basket-btn' -> /subscribe -> freq-weekly + day-Sat + start-1, saved address auto-selected -> 'sub-submit' -> success screen 'Subscription active! 🎉' with correct next delivery date 'Sat Aug 22' (weekly_day=5 alignment verified) -> 'sub-manage-btn' -> /subscriptions shows the sub ACTIVE. Manage: 'sub-pause-<id>' flips to PAUSED, tap again resumes to ACTIVE; 'sub-skip-<id>' advances date; 'sub-cancel-<id>' with two-tap removes the card. Admin dashboard: 'Active subscriptions=1' stat card is rendered. Two RN-web deprecation warnings persist (shadow*, pointerEvents) — non-blocking, already noted in iterations 13/14.

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect on cart (line 78-80) writes AsyncStorage on every render including initial empty state BEFORE the async hydration effect (line 68-69) completes. On a hard page reload the initial empty [] overwrites the persisted cart. Only impacts hard reload / deep-link navigation; tab bar (client-side) nav is fine. Reproduce: add items -> reload URL -> cart shows empty. Fix: gate the persist effect behind the 'ready' flag or use zustand persist middleware.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — repeated from iterations 13/14, non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts
Deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — repeated from iterations 13/14, non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL bug fix: src/store.tsx — gate the AsyncStorage write effect (lines 78-80) behind the `ready` state so it doesn't wipe persisted cart on hard reload. Suggested change: `useEffect(() => { if(!ready) return; AsyncStorage.setItem(CART_KEY, JSON.stringify(cart)); }, [cart, ready]);`.
Optional: replace theme.shadow.* -> boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (long-standing).
Sub-manage-btn appears twice per interaction cycle if user taps then goes back — verify router.replace prevents duplicate history entries (already using replace, safe).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at ~2062 lines (was 1908 in iteration 14). Please split into routers before adding more features — auth, products, orders, admin, subscriptions, contact.

Subscription create/update endpoints don't dedupe or validate that item price still matches the current product price. A user could subscribe with a stale price and receive an outdated per-delivery total forever. Consider re-fetching product prices on order generation in _generate_subscription_order.

run_due_subscriptions is invoked hourly by _subscription_loop. If backend restarts between iterations, still-due subs are picked up on next tick — good. But no cap on how many days behind we back-fill: a sub next_delivery_date=2020-01-01 generates exactly one order and advances one interval from TODAY, so old missed days are silently forgiven. This is correct behavior but worth documenting.

OrderItem.image is a required field — subscribe.tsx correctly includes it in cart items, but manually-constructed test payloads without `image` return 422. Consider making image optional with a placeholder default.

rca_of_issue: Non-blocking cart persistence race in /app/frontend/src/store.tsx: the write effect at lines 78-80 depends on `cart` state which starts as []. On mount, this fires immediately writing [] to AsyncStorage BEFORE the async hydration in lines 56-76 can populate cart from storage. In practice this manifests only when the user hard-reloads (e.g., deep link, page.goto) while items are in the cart; the persisted cart is wiped by the initial [] write. Client-side navigation (bottom tab bar) is unaffected because store isn't remounted. Fix: `useEffect(() => { if (!ready) return; AsyncStorage.setItem(CART_KEY, JSON.stringify(cart)); }, [cart, ready]);`
